rooms.name: Studio Room
rooms.description: A light-filled studio opening onto a private balcony over the harbour. Floor-to-ceiling glass, a plush king bed and a cosy reading corner make it an easy retreat after a day in the city.
features: Plush king bed with premium linen

rooms.name: Premier Room
rooms.description: Wake up to the skyline. The Premier Room pairs a generous sleeping area with a window-side lounge, a bespoke cocktail cabinet and a marble bathroom with a deep soaking tub.

rooms.name: Premier Suite
rooms.description: A one-bedroom suite overlooking the gardens and the bay beyond. A separate living room with designer furnishings gives you space to unwind, entertain or work in comfort.

rooms.name: Bay Suite
rooms.description: Sweeping views across the bay from every corner. The Bay Suite includes a spacious lounge, a dining area with pantry and a private bar, all framed by full-height windows.

rooms.name: Family Suite
rooms.description: Designed with little explorers in mind. A playful kids' room with built-in bunk beds and jungle-inspired wallpaper connects to a calm master bedroom and shared living space.

rooms.name: Presidential Suite
rooms.description: Our most distinguished address. Double-height windows, a curated art collection, a formal living and dining room and a dedicated butler make every stay truly above and beyond.
